parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
You do not need to pass this field if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK+SK) or temporary authorization via Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: commitMessage
parameters.description: Commit message when deleting the file

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
